metric_clarification: Rust allocations/bytes are requested System allocation/reallocation calls and Layout bytes; Go allocations use testing.AllocsPerRun(10), bytes average runtime.MemStats.TotalAlloc deltas with GC disabled for that separate pass. Allocator rounding and representations differ; neither metric is RSS. Timing uses normal Go GC.
remaining_performance_scope: single-stop/prefix constructors, empty/error paths and other palettes
percentile_interpretation: p50/p95 over 31 per-operation batch averages; not individual-call tail latency
